proposals.evidence: DEDR3675 gives Kannada nil/nillu with nind- stem, Kodagu nill- with nipp-/nind-, Malayalam nilkka, Parji nilp-, Gondi imperative nillā and Kurux ijnā (ijjas) stand. Selected survey forms retain these ordinary stem/inflectional variants, including Kurux ījas and Badaga nippə; no extra auxiliary or causative analysis is inferred. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Selected takita/takna/takuda responses retain the simple walking stem with ordinary source endings; tāk-s- formations and fuller phrases are not reduced to this stem. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
